description.en: Sets a persistent, save-file-wide bit flag in a separate flag table from CMND_SET_GLOBAL_BIT_FLAG ("Kiznax", likely tied to the bond/friendship system), identified by a numeric bit index.
Index of the Kiznax bit flag to set.
Optional value to set (defaults to true when omitted).
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Mark a Kiznax-related flag as reached
CMND_SET_GLOBAL_KIZNAX_BIT_FLAG(1609);
